function: Involved in abiotic stress signaling. Tethered to plasma membrane (PM) and probably bound to phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate. Abiotic stresses (drought, salt, H(2)O(2)) trigger phospholipase C mediated PM dislogement and plastidial and nucleocytosolic relocation of TULP3.
subcellular_location: Cell membrane; Peripheral membrane protein; Plastid; Nucleus; Nucleoplasm; Cytoplasm; Phospholipase C activity mediates the release from the plasma membrane and the relocation to plastids, cytoplasm and nucleus.

features.description: Loss of plasma membrane tethering; when associated with A-189.
